question: In zod 4 (github.com/colinhacks/zod, the `zod` package), trace how `z.iso.datetime()` is wired: which classic-layer file exposes the `datetime` function under the `iso` namespace, which core factory/class it delegates to, and where the actual datetime regex/pattern is built. Name the files at each hop.
critical_facts: the `iso.datetime` function lives in packages/zod/src/v4/classic/iso.ts and is surfaced as the `z.iso` namespace via `export * as iso from "./iso.js"` in classic/external.ts
classic/iso.ts `datetime()` delegates to `core._isoDateTime(ZodISODateTime, params)`, and the `$ZodISODateTime` constructor is defined in packages/zod/src/v4/core/schemas.ts
the datetime regex/pattern is produced by the `datetime()` builder in packages/zod/src/v4/core/regexes.ts (the core $ZodISODateTime constructor sets `def.pattern ??= regexes.datetime(def)`)
material_errors: claims `datetime` is a top-level `z.datetime()` (in zod 4 it is under the `z.iso` namespace, from classic/iso.ts) rather than tracing the iso namespace
cites the legacy v3 string `.datetime()` implementation (packages/zod/src/v3/...) as the zod 4 wiring
names dist/ build output instead of the src files
evidence: packages/zod/src/v4/classic/iso.ts:6 — `export function datetime(...) { return core._isoDateTime(ZodISODateTime, params); }`; :2 imports `ZodISODateTime` from `./schemas.js`
packages/zod/src/v4/core/regexes.ts:119 — `export function datetime(args: {...})` builds the pattern
